def big_negate_sorted_asc(figures):
    """Compile a cleaned, sign-adjusted summary of battery drain readings.

    A monitoring service records battery drain readings for a fleet of field
    devices. Each reading is expressed in whole milliampere-hours, where
    positive figures denote net discharge and negative figures denote net
    recharge over the sampling window. figures is a list of ints. Prior to
    publication, readings of small magnitude are treated as sensor noise and
    removed from consideration; the surviving readings are then restated under
    the ledger convention of the downstream reporting system, in which the
    sign of every entry is reversed, and the restated entries are presented in
    a uniform order. Apply the following steps IN ORDER, exactly as stated.
    Step 1: discard the values of figures whose absolute value is 10 or less.
    Step 2: map every kept value v to -v. Step 3: sort the results in
    ASCENDING order and return them as a list. The examples below illustrate
    the required behavior, including the treatment of an empty sequence of
    readings.

    >>> big_negate_sorted_asc([])
    []
    >>> big_negate_sorted_asc([-13, -2, 0, 1, 2, 2, 15])
    [-15, 13]
    """
